items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are available in ChatGPT Work and Codex.
summary: OpenAI announced availability of GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API for eligible users.
The release broadens access to models intended for professional work, coding and agentic workflows.
items.why: This can change how teams prototype, analyse information and automate repeatable knowledge work.

The company plans to expand access to AI sourcing tools across its regional offices.

items.title: Anthropic’s Residency is accepting applications from established technical leaders.
summary: Anthropic’s paid, fixed-term Residency programme targets technical leaders who want to move into empirical AI-safety research.
It welcomes adjacent quantitative and engineering backgrounds, and prior machine-learning experience is not required.
items.why: It reflects continued competition for transferable technical talent, not only conventionally trained AI researchers.

language.example: She hopes to transition into an AI-platform role from payments engineering.
The company offers a fixed-term programme for experienced engineers exploring research roles.
For this graduate role, prior experience in e-commerce is not required.

items.title: Amazon Saudi Arabia has launched a 12-day White Friday sale.
summary: Amazon Saudi Arabia has begun a 12-day White Friday campaign that combines promotional pricing with Prime-related delivery and entertainment benefits.
It shows how marketplaces package commercial offers and fulfilment propositions during a peak retail period.
items.why: Retail-tech teams must prepare pricing, inventory, checkout and last-mile services for promotional demand spikes.

language.example: The operations team increased on-call coverage for the peak shopping period.
Promotional pricing must be reflected consistently across the app and checkout flow.
The brand packages fast delivery together with exclusive member benefits.

items.title: UK labour-market data show softer hiring conditions.
summary: The Office for National Statistics reported a mixed UK labour-market picture: employment rose and unemployment fell in the latest quarter, while payroll employment and vacancies declined.
Smaller businesses cited higher labour and operating costs as factors affecting hiring.
items.why: Recruiters should separate headline employment figures from near-term vacancy demand and employer cost pressure.

language.example: The latest hiring data presents a mixed picture across different functions.
Higher operating costs may affect hiring decisions in smaller companies.
The decline in vacancies was concentrated in administrative and support roles.

items.title: EU product-identifier requirements are now operational for import distance sales.
summary: Mandatory product identifiers took effect on 1 November 2026.
EU guidance states that product identifiers must now be declared for relevant import distance sales.
Generic product descriptions are no longer sufficient.
items.why: Cross-border e-commerce platforms need reliable product-data flows, validation and compliance ownership across sellers, marketplaces and customs operations.

language.example: The new product-data requirement came into effect this month.
Cross-border shipments may be subject to additional customs checks.
The platform must capture and transmit product data accurately.
